publicWelcome.title: Welcome | SGEU
publicWelcome.subtitle: University Spaces Management System
publicWelcome.description: A platform to centralize and simplify the management of university spaces, their location, features and assignments.
publicWelcome.projectTitle: A clear structure for university information
publicWelcome.projectDescription: SGEU simplifies the consultation and management of faculties, buildings, floors and spaces. The platform organizes information into related levels and brings the data together in a single, accessible and consistent environment.
publicWelcome.organizedInformationDescription: An understandable hierarchy connecting each space with its floor, building and faculty.
publicWelcome.simpleQueryDescription: Search and filters designed to locate information directly.
publicWelcome.centralizedDataDescription: A single system for maintaining a consistent view of university spaces.
publicWelcome.aboutUsDescription: M2D2 Solutions is the team responsible for designing and developing SGEU, a solution aimed at simplifying university space management through a clear, organized and accessible interface.
publicWelcome.footerDescription: Project developed by M2D2 Solutions in the academic context of the University of Vigo.
